Sistema Antiderrapante Inoperante

A condition where the antiskid braking system is not operational, requiring alternate braking procedures and possible performance penalties.

Definition

A condition where the antiskid braking system is not operational, requiring alternate braking procedures and possible performance penalties.

Operational example

Antiskid system inoperative; braking will be manual and stopping distance increased.

Localized term
